{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
sales_df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Convert revenue from string to float
sales_df['revenue'] = sales_df['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Filter for completed orders from LOYAL customers
loyal_completed = sales_df[
    (sales_df['customer_segment'] == 'loyal') &
    (sales_df['status'] == 'completed')
]

# Confirm the number of such orders
print(f'Number of completed orders from LOYAL customers: {len(loyal_completed)}')

# Confirm that no refunded orders are included
print(f'Refunded orders in this group: {loyal_completed[loyal_completed["status"] == "refunded"].shape[0]}')

# Check if any revenue values are zero or negative
print(f'Zero or negative revenue in this group: {loyal_completed[loyal_completed["revenue"] <= 0].shape[0]}')"}
